_comment: Written by `pnpm marketing:shots` (apps/admin/scripts/marketing-shots.mjs). Each entry carries the capture's TRUE pixel dimensions so components never hardcode a wrong aspect ratio, plus alt text recorded at capture time so it can't drift from the picture. Empty until the pipeline has been run against a seeded local environment; CapabilityShowcase renders a 'pending capture' placeholder for any missing key. NOTE: four entries are nulled with an `invalidReason` — their PNGs did not show the surface the entry claimed (three were the same ngrok error page, one was the sign-in screen). A nulled entry reads as 'not captured yet', so `screen()` returns null and consumers render nothing rather than the wrong picture. Re-run the pipeline against a live local env to refill them.
